title: The Celtic Sea Through Time and Space: Ecosystem Modeling to Unravel Fishing and Climate Change Impacts on Food-Web Structure and Dynamics
authors: Hernvann, Gascuel, Gruss, Druon, Kopp, Perez, Piroddi and Robert
loadability_evidence: 50 groups. Authors specify model parameters and diet in Appendix SB; Figshare DOI match verified.
loadability_class: C — parameter and diet tables inspected; model import not tested
quality_rationale: Inspected downloaded supporting DOCX: Table B4 (fifth DOCX table,55 rows) has B/PB/QB/EE and other basic parameters; Table B2 (second and third DOCX tables,56 rows each) contains numeric 1985 diet matrix across predators1-50, including whiting/haddock/pouts rows. Table B3 contains landings/discards. These are actual numeric reconstruction inputs; no model-load test. Full model import and numerical reconstruction remain untested.
extraction_readiness: Parameter and diet tables located; transcription and balance audit required
geometry_method: No defensible digital study boundary located
geometry_note: No author model polygon or explicit bounding coordinates extracted; do not substitute the LME boundary.
recommendation: Celtic Sea component of LME; 1985 baseline, simulations to 2016.
coverage_note: Celtic Sea component of LME; 1985 baseline, simulations to 2016.
